channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama, as they pray the Litany of the Sacred Heart. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Zero Ad Roundtable
channel.desc: Journalist Colm Flynn sits down with Fr. Mitch Pacwa, Dr. Stefana Dan Laing, and producer Leo Severino to discuss how "Zero AD: The Birth of Christ" was crafted for the big screen. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Rosary, The Spiritual Sword Of Our Lady
channel.desc: Fr. Donald Calloway looks at the history of the rosary, its victories and its champions, in a presentation that will make you want to unsheath your spiritual sword, and take up the battle against evil. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Holy Rosary From Lourdes
channel.desc: Pilgrims from around the world gather and pray the Rosary from the Lourdes grotto in France, site of the famous apparitions by the Blessed Virgin Mary in 1858. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Sunday Mass From Lourdes
channel.desc: (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Le Chapelet De La Divine Misericorde
channel.desc: The Chaplet of the Divine Mercy is prayed in French by the parish of Our Lady of the Nativity in La Garde, France. Our Lord taught Sister Faustina in Poland, the five decades to recite. Spoken and sung with portrayals of Jesus' Passion and Resurrection. (15 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Reflections With Fr. Leo Clifford
channel.desc: Father Leo Clifford reflects on some of the writings of Fr. Frederick William Faber of England concerning the Blessed Sacrament and some of the devotions we have - 40 Hours, Perpetual Adoration, visits. (15 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Sunday Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass each Sunday from Our Lady of the Angels Chapel as friars intone Gregorian chant. Visiting clergy concelebrate this sacrament. LIVE Sundays at 8 am Eastern. (80 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Litany Of The Sacred Heart Of Jesus
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama, as they pray the Litany of the Sacred Heart. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Father Spitzer?s Universe
channel.desc: Father Spitzer discusses how verified miracles performed today in the name of Jesus serve as compelling evidence that the miraculous events recorded in the gospels truly occurred. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Monastic Voice
channel.desc: A look at the Benedictine monks at Pluscarden Abbey. Abandoned after the Reformation but revived in the 1940's, it is the oldest monastery of men in use in the United Kingdom. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Long Ride Home With Bear Woznick
channel.desc: Bear Woznick and Tony Orband cross Florida, Alabama and Mississippi, following the same route that Bear once traveled on bicycle. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn Bookmark
channel.desc: Fr. Christopher J. Seith joins Doug Keck to explore how Josef Pieper's sacramental worldview helps us cut through the noise and distractions of the world and keep our focus on God. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Vaticano
channel.desc: We revisit Pope Pius XII?s controversial pontificate and the efforts to protect Jews during World War II. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Church And The Poor
channel.desc: Exploring what it means to carry our Cross daily, Fr. Ho Lung of the Missionaries of the Poor, continues his retreat on self-knowledge. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Body And Spirituality
channel.desc: The idealist desire for human perfection hurts our compassion toward others. But with humility and knowledge one can accept imperfections in oneself, keep improving oneself and increase the charity necessary to live well with the spouse. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Sunday Vespers With Benediction
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word as they celebrate Vespers and Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament from Our Lady of the Angels Chapel in Irondale, Alabama. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Sunday Best With Fr. Groeschel
channel.desc: Fr. Groeschel fills our hearts with hope as he reveals one statement that will help each of us escape the prison of ?yourself? and jump into a relationship with another person. That statement is ?I believe in God.?. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Mother Angelica Live Classics
channel.desc: Mother explains how Jesus loved us before we even knew him. She proposes the question, "What does it mean to know Jesus?". (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Life On The Rock
channel.desc: Fr. Mark and the Franciscan Friars of the Eternal Word are back. Interviews, spiritual insights from the friars, music videos and much more. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn News Nightly
channel.desc: EWTN News Nightly recaps 2026 Midterm Election Day as Democrats win control of the House and Senate. We break down the biggest races, President Trump's reaction, pro-life ballot measures and the Catholic vote, plus Pope Leo XIV on the importance of engaging in political life. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Sunday Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass each Sunday from Our Lady of the Angels Chapel as friars intone Gregorian chant. Visiting clergy concelebrate this sacrament. LIVE Sundays at 8 am Eastern. (80 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Litany Of The Sacred Heart Of Jesus
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama, as they pray the Litany of the Sacred Heart. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Saints Of China: Martyrs Of The Middle Kingdom
channel.desc: Dr. Anthony Clark discusses the roles of religious orders such as the Franciscans, Dominicans, and Vincentians in China and the anti-Christian uprising of the Boxer Rebellion in 1900. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn Live
channel.desc: Author Grady Connolly joins Fr. Mitch to share his extraordinary journey visiting all 94 Catholic Basilicas in America and what makes each of these sacred spaces truly special. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Bob And Penny Lord Present
channel.desc: Bob and Penny Lord look at the life of St. Louis de Montfort, a French priest known for promoting devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary in his writings and preaching. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Fr. Apostoli: Fatima, Heaven's Peace Plan
channel.desc: Fr. Apostoli introduces the viewer to the first apparition in Fatima - the Angel of Peace. He came to prepare the way for Our Lady?s later visits. His was a vision to prepare the souls of the children for a greater love of God. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Case For Marriage
channel.desc: Noah Lett and Dr. David Anders review how modern society is now defining marriage. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Living Right With Dr. Ray
channel.desc: Dr. Ray encourages us to keep things in perspective when faced with daily cares by offering them to God?s providence. Sister John Dominic shares her experience of religious life. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Consuming The Word
channel.desc: Scott Hahn and Mike Aquilina discuss how Catholics are a people of the Word and not simply a ?people of the Book". (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Chaplet Of Divine Mercy
channel.desc: From the chapel of the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy in Stockbridge, Massachusetts. (20 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Reflections With Fr. Leo Clifford
channel.desc: Our Lord said in the Gospel, "I have come that you may have life and have it more abundantly." A stepping-off point for Father to explain radiant living from Christ's point of view. (10 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Saints Vs. Scoundrels
channel.desc: When both saint and scoundrel are confronted with their fates, Maximilian Kolbe still chooses to trust Christ?s Divine Will, and embrace his suffering and eventual martyrdom. Part 2 of 2. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Monastic Voice
channel.desc: A look at the Benedictine monks at Pluscarden Abbey. Abandoned after the Reformation but revived in the 1940's, it is the oldest monastery of men in use in the United Kingdom. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Hi Lucy
channel.desc: Lucy learns from Sister Grace about dealing with academic difficulties and the use of faith and prayer during these times. (15 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Adventure Catechism
channel.desc: Some people are called to be an instrument of God among His people. Learn about the sacrament of Holy Orders, and the important role priests play in the Church, for those who are sick or coming to the end of their life. (15 minutes).[(96057)]

channel.title: The Adventures of Ozzie & Harriet
channel.desc: Long-running sitcom "The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet," based on a radio show of the same name, is one of the shows from the period that epitomized the values of the 1950s and early '60s through the all-American nuclear family. The series stars real-life married couple Ozzie and Harriet Nelson as well as their sons, David and Ricky. The focus of the series is the Nelsons' home life as they deal with run-of-the-mill problems that families of the day faced. By the time the show went off the air, it had produced 435 episodes over 14 seasons.
